ohtani.title: Emmet Sheehan's superb outing fuels Dodgers' 6-3 win
ohtani.blurb: Teoscar Hernández belts a three-run homer and Emmet Sheehan strikes out 10 to lead the Dodgers over the Reds, 6-3

imanaga.title: Craig Counsell recaps the Cubs' win vs. Pirates
imanaga.blurb: Craig Counsell talks about the feisty Cubs offense, Alex Bregman's two-run home run, how the second half of the season is going and more

suzuki.title: Acuña Jr., Albies and Baldwin power Braves to a win
suzuki.blurb: Ronald Acuña Jr., Ozzie Albies and Drake Baldwin hit homers, backing Martín Pérez's 100th career win to lead Braves to a win over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Spencer Torkelson's three-run home run ignites win
okamoto.blurb: Spencer Torkelson's three-run home run powers the Tigers to a 10-1 win over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Brayan Rocchio delivers walk-off hit vs. White Sox
murakami.blurb: Brayan Rocchio comes through with a walk-off double and Travis Bazzana goes deep twice in the Guardians' 7-6 over the White Sox

matsui.title: Fernando Tatis Jr., Manny Machado lift Padres to win
matsui.blurb: Fernando Tatis Jr. collects three hits and two RBIs, plus Manny Machado crushes a two-run home run to lift the Padres to a 6-4 victory over the Giants
